analysis.reason: The test expected HTTP 200 for a valid product ID (1) but the API returned HTTP 404 with response {"message":"Requested item not found"}. This indicates the API did not return the expected product resource and prevents validation of the expected response schema and headers. While a missing test-data seed could also cause this, the observed behavior is inconsistent with the positive test expectation and therefore suggests an application-level problem.
analysis.recommendedAction: 1) Confirm whether product ID 1 is expected to exist in the test environment (check test data seeding). 2) If test data is present, inspect application logs, database queries, and the /products/{id} handler to identify why the resource lookup yields 404. 3) Reproduce the request manually (curl/postman) and verify response headers and body. 4) After identifying root cause, either restore/seed the expected test data or fix the API implementation so it returns 200 and a response matching the ProductResponse schema.
